content.text:
Lifetime spend is taken as lifetime_gross_nzd on dim_customers (items + shipping before refunds). The question doesn't say gross or net. Net LTV exists in rpt_customer_ltv but has no city, and the question names lifetime spend, which fits gross best. Customers who joined in August 2026 are filtered by signed_up_on.

```json
{"sql":"select city, signed_up_on, round(avg(lifetime_gross_nzd), 2) as avg_lifetime_spend_nzd, count(*) as customers from marts.dim_customers where signed_up_on >= date '2026-08-01' and signed_up_on < date '2026-09-01' group by city, signed_up_on order by signed_up_on, city","tables_used":["marts.dim_customers"],"assumptions":["Lifetime spend interpreted as lifetime_gross_nzd (items + shipping before refunds), in NZD","Joined in August 2026 means signed_up_on between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-31","Customers with no orders are included, with their lifetime_gross_nzd values as stored (may be null or 0)","Grouped by city and signed_up_on date"]}
```
